name: Cornered!
placementTarget: Rulebook page 10, rule sticker G, under Movement Actions and above Drive/Ferry.
summary: Title CORNERED! Your character gets exposed when your pawn leaves a location containing 1 or more Hollow Men figures. The letter G is the rulebook slot. It is not printed on the sticker.

mechanics.timing: When your pawn leaves a location.
mechanics.effect: Leaving a location that contains 1 or more Hollow Men figures gives that character 1 exposure.
restrictions: The trigger is leaving, not beginning a turn there.
One or more figures is enough. The sticker does not add a further exposure for each extra figure.
Area 15 repeats this sentence on the board legend.
